newsitem.title: USA: Activist group still pursues Banc One case.
newsitem.headline: Activist group still pursues Banc One case.

text.p: Inner City Press/Community on the Move, a Bronx, N.Y. activist group which together with groups in Texas and Delaware sought to block the $7.9 billion acquisition of First USA Inc by Banc One Corp, said Friday it is disappointed it failed to win an emergency order to block the deal but it is still pursuing the case.

Matthew Lee, executive director of Inner City Press, said the U.S. Court of Appeals in Washington D.C. denied its request for an emergency stay at 1045 EDT. Shortly after, Banc One, based in Columbus, Ohio announced that the merger had been completed.
Banc One shareholders approved the transaction Thursday and First USA shareholders approved it Friday morning.

Lee said the legal challenge to the Fed's approval of the transaction continues in the appeals court. The group has said in its court filings that it belives it was wrong for the Federal Reserve to approve the deal conditionally pending a further review of lending practices at Banc One units.
